Continuation and ending of the letter, signed ‘P. Deligne’. There is no title, date, salutation, own page number or total count on this sheet; archive 75 is retained only as a comment. The writer represents a global class by local extensions on an affine cover, introduces transition isomorphisms, and states that the obstruction to their cocycle relation ‘est donné par d_2 eta’. He gives the displayed differential and says ‘La même construction marche dans le cas analytique’ and ‘on conclut par une nouvelle application de GAGA’. The first H has one ordinary upright-and-crossbar structure, followed by a raised 0 and a still higher parenthesized alg. The first display is H^{0^{(\mathrm{alg})}}, with actual parentheses around alg.

The sheaf-functor initials have looped/curling forms, transcribed \mathscr{E}xt^1 and \mathscr{H}om. The cohomology H and each K are ordinary single-stroke capitals. The ideal letter is looped \mathscr{N}. Each occurrence was checked on this page.

The transition arrow has one shaft, a right arrowhead, and a single wavy stroke above. Both restrictions show U_i\cap U_j with an arched intersection sign. The source suffix resolves to j; the target remains i|j|k from its own merged strokes.

The last display has low numeral 2 after d, H^0 at the source, \mathscr{E}xt^1 inside it, and H^2 at the target with \mathscr{H}om. The long arrow points right and both outer expressions close with two parentheses.

The source/target diagnostic is conditional: a map j to i composed with k to j has source k and target i, matching the written ij, jk, ik pattern. This use of the preferred i is not evidence for its obscured strokes; the consolidated target remains i/j/k.
